title: krn task publish ships edits of published records made in the main checkout
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16: after `krn task publish` shipped t-1nkf30z and t-ahsmyfp, `krn task edit` in the main checkout modified tasks/<id>.json in place, and `krn task publish` then printed "no pending task records"; the edits needed a manual lane worktree and PR (38c46db).
Outcome: an edit of a published record made in the main checkout goes to the pending ref like a new record, and `krn task publish` ships it; the main checkout's tasks/ stays clean.
Proof: a test in test/task/ edits a published record in a main-checkout fixture and asserts the pending ref holds the edit and the worktree file is unchanged.
Files: src/task/
